note: mass_kg and max_rpm are the UI values. Everything else is a PLACEHOLDER until calibration (track D). torque_curve is built from the 2026 limits in regulation_eras.json: engine power = 44.76 % thermal efficiency times the fuel energy flow limit (0.27 * rpm + 165 MJ/h below 10500 rpm, 3000 MJ/h above, C5.2.3 and C5.2.4), plus the ERS-K at 350 kW capped at 500 N.m (C5.2.7, C5.2.11). That gives the Core doc's 723 kW from 10500 rpm to the rev limit (decision D3). The ERS-K speed taper (C5.2.8) and energy limits are not modelled. power_map_scale is the desktop UI's kPower table. gear_ratios are a progressive set whose top gear gives the UI's 340 km/h at the rev limit with a 3.20 final drive. driveline_efficiency is the middle of the Core doc's 0.93 to 0.97 range. The inertias are order-of-magnitude guesses.
